svg.title: Dry-dropper, floating line — leader diagram
svg.desc: Leader schematic for Dry-dropper, floating line: 9 ft · 4X · 6 lb Knotless tapered leader, then 2 ft · 5X · 5 lb Tippet to dropper.
svg.text: When: Shallower water, spread-out fish, or when you want the dry
to actually be eaten rather than just float.
Not to scale — lengths are on the labels.
